src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Correct an expense request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: The details needed to correct an existing expense: its category, date, description, amount, optional flock and note, plus the version being edited.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: New expense category request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: The request to add a new expense category, which carries just the category name.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Record expense request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: The details needed to record a new expense: category, date, description, amount, an optional flock it relates to, and an optional note.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Expense sample-data checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Lets the demo and test data loader look up expense categories and expenses by name and count them, so sample data is not added twice. Not registered in Production.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Expenses feature outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: The list of everything the expenses area can do: record, correct and list expenses, and create, rename or switch off categories.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Edit expense category request
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: The request to rename a category, switch it on or off, or both at once.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Correct expense
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Carries out a correction to an existing expense, checking the category, date and optional flock, and saving the changed record.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Correct expense checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Refuses a correction that has missing or invalid details, such as a bad date or amount.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Record expense
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Records a new expense after checking its category, flock and the farm's currency, then saves it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Record expense checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Refuses a new expense that has missing or invalid details, such as a bad date or amount.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Add expense category
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Adds a new expense category for the farm and saves it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Add expense category checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Refuses a new category whose name is blank or too long.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Expenses feature
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Hands each expense request to the right step: recording, correcting, listing, and managing categories.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Expense storage outline
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Describes how expenses and expense categories are stored and looked up, without saying how the database does it.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Edit expense category
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Renames a category or switches it on or off, then saves the change.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.name: Edit expense category checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Financ.description: Refuses a category edit whose name is blank or too long.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Finance/Exp.name: Expense
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Finance/Exp.description: One record of money spent: when, how much, on what, in which category, and optionally for which flock.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Finance/Exp.name: Expense category
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Finance/Exp.description: A farm's named bucket for sorting spending, such as Feed, Vet or Repairs, which can be switched on or off.
